But from Friday, members of the public will finally be able to visit a pioneering command bunker that was ordered by Winston Churchill and proved a vital defence during the second world war. The Fan Bay plotting room , which is encased in concrete, housed the first land-based computer-aided targeting system. articles.title: Young people should get fewer welfare benefits, according to Milburn review on the workforce – UK politics live
articles.summary_snippet: Milburn’s review is considering how to address the growing number of young people classified as not in education, employment or training The Alan Milburn report on youth unemployment, or Neets (young people not in education, employment or training), is expected to lead to the biggest overhaul of the welfare system for at least a decade (when Iain Duncan Smith merged six different benefits into universal credit). Arguably, it could be even bigger. It is certainly the most heavily-trailed benefits reform plan in recent history. Milburn, a former Labour cabinet minister, began pitch-rolling with the publication of an interim report in May . Unusually for a Westminster document, it was a compelling read, and was widely praised at the time . Since then, barely a week has gone by without Milburn dropping further hints about what the final report will say. Milburn says he has government backing

articles.title: ‘Maga is dead, Maga is effeminate’: why has the manosphere rejected Trump?
articles.summary_snippet: As public mood has shifted on Israel-Gaza and the Iran war, so has the manosphere’s devotion to the US president Earlier this week, Donald Trump announced that the UFC president, Dana White, was to become his press secretary. The US president hoped the creator of Power Slap, a face-slapping league which one of the world’s leading neurologists called “a sport inconsistent with the intelligence of humans”, might be the right man to deliver his daily rebuttals to the media. Trump later backtracked on the appointment, saying he was “only kidding” , yet it is easy to understand why he might be pining for White’s muscles, trash talk and thirst for athletic violence. White is representative of the way Trump transcended politics in 2024 to become a celebrated figure in the manosphere, the loosely defined cluster of male content creators who have a direct line to America’s bored and aggrieved you
